newsitem.title: USA: Cypress and Keystone complete Scotsman stock buy.
newsitem.headline: Cypress and Keystone complete Scotsman stock buy.

text.p: Cypress Group and Keystone Inc Thursday said they have completed the previously announced acquisition of approximately 90 percent of the common stock of Scotsman Holdings Inc for approximately $675 million.
The Scotsman Holdings acquisition is part of the recapitalization of Williams Scotsman, a unit of Scotsman Holdings.
In the recapitalization, Williams Scotsman refinanced its existing credit facility with a new $300 million revolving credit facility and issued $400 million of 9-7/8 percent Senior Notes due 2007.
In addition, Williams Scotsman completed the tender of its 9-1/2 percent Senior Secured Notes due 2000 and its Series B 11 percent Seior Notes due 2004.
William Scotsman is a lessor of mobile office units in 33 states.
Cypress Group manages a private equity fund that invests in privately negotiated transactions.
Keystone Inc is the principle investment arm for Robert Bass and his associates.
